question:
**Identify the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the following sentence and select its correct spelling from the given options.**

Factories have to follow a proper procedure to dispose of the hazerdous material.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Hazardous**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given word "**hazerdous**" is incorrect due to a misspelling.
 
• The correct spelling includes the letter "**a**" after the "**z**" and before the "**a**," forming the word "**hazardous**."
 
• "**Hazardous**" means involving risk or danger. (जोखिम या ख़तरा शामिल हो)
 
• The correct spelling is crucial for effective communication and understanding in written language.
 
 
• **Example**: *Entering an abandoned building without proper protective gear is hazardous to your health.*
